title: Add C++ version of LinkedList
body:
**C++ Linked List Implementation**

Implements a singly linked list in C++ translated from Python, covering:
- Node creation & traversal
- Insert at start, after a node, and at end
- Search and length calculation
- Manual memory cleanup via delete
author: kittu-54545

title: Resolve issue #8 by adding database interview preparation guide
body:
## What this PR does

This PR resolves issue #8 by adding a structured database interview preparation guide to strengthen the database portion of the roadmap.

## Included topics

- relational databases and NoSQL basics
- normalization forms including 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, and BCNF
- joins
- SQL categories including DDL, DML, DCL, DQL, and transaction control
- SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, TRUNCATE, and UPSERT
- explicit vs implicit transactions
- control-of-flow concepts such as CASE and IF-ELSE
- keys and constraints
- stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views
- materialized views
- ACID properties
- transactions and isolation levels
- indexing including B-tree, B+ tree, and bitmap indexing
- database design and optimization
- partitioning
- PostgreSQL vs DynamoDB
- MongoDB and Redis interview-oriented notes
- recommended study resources

## Why this helps

This makes the database section more complete and more useful for backend, full-stack, and system design interview preparation.
author: kariebi
